summary.text: Ann Johnson Stewart is a Democratic state senator who has represented Minnesota Senate District 45 since November 2024 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A civil engineer and University of Minnesota instructor, she says her focus as a senator is infrastructure and the environment.

paragraphs.text: Ann Johnson Stewart earned a bachelor's degree in civil engineering from the University of Wisconsin at Platteville in 1986 and a master's degree in civil engineering from the University of Minnesota at Twin Cities in 1994.
Ballotpedia lists her career experience as working as a civil engineer, teaching at the University of Minnesota, and owning Professional Engineering Services.

In a 2026 Ballotpedia survey, she said she grew up in northern Wisconsin, started a consulting business in 1995 that grew to employ more than 30 people, and sold it in 2022 to focus on running for the Senate.
Stewart took office in the Minnesota Senate on November 25, 2024, succeeding Kelly Morrison, and Ballotpedia also lists her as having represented District 44 from 2021 to 2023.
In the survey, she said she is Vice Chair of the Senate Transportation Committee and a member of the Capital Investment, Environment, and State and Local Government committees.
She listed infrastructure development and maintenance and affordable health care among her campaign messages.
